limits: No claim of a connected generative AI provider from scripted replies.
No autonomous wanted-level police pursuit/arrest implementation claim.
No untagged legacy NPC deletion claim; existing unidentified actors are conservatively suppressed/reported.

right_click.observed: Ordinary right-click with empty hand selected this existing worker, replied by name and displayed the [Talk] // prompt. Courier right-click also succeeded at16:12:03.

hold.observed: Normal explicit dialogue stopped the selected ambient actor and made it face the player; NoAI1 was read from the held villager. A normal punch immediately restored movement. No actor AI was changed by console/test commands.

retaliation.observed: One ordinary barehand punch produced hit feedback, assault/wanted1 and the fights-back message. The worker followed the retreating player and repeatedly reduced the visible health bar. Player was returned to protected spawn after the bounded check; no downed message occurred.
retaliation.qualification: This health change is observed during a retaliation sequence; it is not an assertion of a precise number of strikes because normal regeneration also applies.

flee.observed: After ordinary conversation and right-click, one barehand punch produced runs-for-safety text. The courier immediately left her held position and ran away; she did not retaliate.

population.qualification: Native observation covered10 nearby actors, not a32-actor load/stress scenario. The hard32 maximum and four admissions are additionally tested in policy tests.

behavior_acceptance.test_setup: Only the ordinary QA player was positioned/oriented via isolated staging console after concrete-floor and air clearance checks. NPCs were not teleported, directly damaged, or AI-mutated by test commands. All selection, conversation, hits, retreat and eating used the actual client. Normal starter food restored health after retaliation; no health/setmode/invulnerability command was used.
